title: Circles within a Rectangle - Calculator
description: Estimates the maximum number of circles that may fit within a rectangle. Use this calculator to determine how many pipes, wires, or other circular objects fit within a conduit or similar rectangular space. Input rectangle dimensions (height and width) and circle diameter.

components.content: Calculate the maximum number of circles that fit within a rectangle

outputs.label: Total Circles (Triangular Pattern)
outputs.formula: inputs.pattern_type === 'triangular' ? Math.floor(inputs.rectangle_width / inputs.circle_diameter) * Math.floor((inputs.rectangle_height - inputs.circle_diameter / 2) / (inputs.circle_diameter * Math.sqrt(3) / 2)) + Math.floor((inputs.rectangle_width - inputs.circle_diameter / 2) / inputs.circle_diameter) : 0

outputs.label: Total Circles (Maximum)
outputs.formula: Math.max(Math.floor(inputs.rectangle_width / inputs.circle_diameter) * Math.floor(inputs.rectangle_height / inputs.circle_diameter), Math.floor(inputs.rectangle_width / inputs.circle_diameter) * Math.floor((inputs.rectangle_height - inputs.circle_diameter / 2) / (inputs.circle_diameter * Math.sqrt(3) / 2)) + Math.floor((inputs.rectangle_width - inputs.circle_diameter / 2) / inputs.circle_diameter))
